grh_1513d7676f16bf8e6669.title: Our Daughter Barbara
paragraphs: Laura Marshall is deeply devoted to her husband Steve and to Barbara, Steve's daughter from his first marriage, but a man from Laura's past threatens the family. Before coming to Rivers End, Laura had fallen in love with married Carl Gilbert and, after discovering he never intended to leave his wife, drove her car through a guardrail in despair. She recovered, began a new life and later married Steve. Months into that marriage, however, Laura angrily went out with Carl one night after quarreling with Steve because he would not leave an ill Barbara to take Laura on a trip. Carl later returns broke and demands $5,000. He still has Laura's old love letters and threatens to combine them with evidence of that night out to persuade Barbara's bitter maternal grandmother, who once lost a custody fight with Steve, to reopen the case by portraying Laura as an unfit stepmother. Unable to raise the money without Steve learning why, Laura turns to Dr. Christian. Christian brings Carl and Steve together and forces the blackmail into the open. Steve is initially shocked and Laura, believing he values her only as a mother for Barbara, prepares to leave. At that moment Steve recognizes that he loves Laura herself as much as ever. He stops her, forgives her, and they return home together to Barbara, while Carl's leverage disappears.

grh_1568a3497107a1c833b6.title: No Greater Dream
paragraphs: Biochemist John Sanderley and his terminally ill scientist wife Mary decide to use her approaching death to test whether the human soul can exist apart from the body. They build a sealed glass chamber with a single outlet leading to a vial, hoping to isolate whatever leaves Mary at death and then establish communication with it. When Mary dies, John sees a luminous form emerge from her, change shape and enter the vial. His colleagues can identify no known element or ordinary atomic substance in the strange glow. John later receives the cryptic message '4W' before the light leaves the vial. In hospital ward 4W, a woman has just delivered a stillborn boy, but the infant suddenly begins to move. The episode leaves the implication that Mary's departing life force has found a new body.

grh_15b25ab406600a7e7165.title: Punishment and Crime
paragraphs: Former sheriff Ed Pettigrew recalls the mystery of identical-seeming brothers Jubal and Jidiah Siluto, one gentle and one vicious, after a stranger is found shot beside their isolated house. Evidence points to Jidiah, yet his supposed sickroom is empty and Jubal insists that his brother has escaped. Pettigrew eventually learns that the brothers were not twins at all: years of buried rage over Jidiah's betrayal and destruction of Jubal's fiancée fractured Jubal's mind, and he had been unconsciously living as both personalities. The murdered stranger is the real Jidiah, returned after fifteen years and killed by Jubal; convicted of murder but judged already deeply punished, Jubal is committed to an institution for the criminally insane.
